Location

Sur La Mer 2, Jumeirah 1

Sur La Mer is Dubai’s premier Mediterranean-inspired waterfront villa community, nestled along the pristine Jumeirah coastline. Residents enjoy direct beach access, a marina promenade, and an exclusive gated lifestyle steps from the Arabian Gulf.

  • Private beach & marina promenade
  • 5 min to Jumeirah Beach Road
  • 10 min to Downtown Dubai
  • 12 min to Dubai International Airport
  • Walking distance to La Mer beach
  • Surrounded by dining & retail
